name: commander-v
description: Bundle selected file contents and project trees into one clipboard snapshot for code reviews, documentation, and AI workflows.

commanderV.includeProjectTree.description: Include a project tree alongside file contents. Turn off for files only. The Copy Project Tree command always copies only the tree.

commanderV.projectTreeDepth.description: Maximum tree depth. Always applies to Copy Project Tree; for combined copies, not applied when Prune Project Tree is enabled.

commanderV.pruneProjectTree.description: Limit the tree to only include files that have been selected

commanderV.orderFilesBy.description: Specify how to sort files when concatenating their content

commanderV.ignoreFile.title: Ignore File
commanderV.ignoreFile.description: Ignore file path relative to the workspace folder (or the copied folder outside a workspace). Extends built-in exclusions for folder contents and project trees. Explicitly selected files are still copied. Set to an empty string to use only built-in exclusions.

commanderV.useDefaultIgnores.description: Skip common dependencies, build output, caches, repository internals, and local environment files when copying folders or trees. Project ignore rules can override these defaults; explicitly selected files are still copied.

commanderV.commentAtFileBegin.description: Opening comment shown at the beginning of every file. Use $file as a placeholder for the file path

commanderV.commentAtFileEnd.description: Closing comment shown at the end of every file. Use $file as a placeholder for the file path

commanderV.includeSeparator.description: Insert a visual separator between concatenated files to improve readability

commanderV.separatorCharacter.description: The character to use for the separator between file contents (max 3 characters)

commanderV.separatorLength.description: The length of the separator between file contents (1-120)

commanderV.wrapInCodeBlock.description: Wrap the concatenated file contents in a code block (```)

commanderV.playSoundOnComplete.description: Play a sound after output is copied successfully to your clipboard

commanderV.readFromEditor.description: Read unsaved contents from any open editor tab; otherwise read the last saved file

enumDescriptions: Box-drawing branches (├──, └──). Best with a monospace font.
Plain ASCII branches (|--, `--) for apps with limited font support.
commanderV.treeFormat.description: Branch characters used in project trees.

commanderV.wrapTreeInCodeBlock.description: Wrap the project tree in a Markdown code block without a language label to preserve spacing in chat apps. Applies to tree-only and combined copies. Disable for raw tree text.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Copying is supported. Executable v.config.js overrides are only loaded in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Commander V currently supports local files and remote filesystem workspaces.
